claim: In svc-env.ts, setEnvironments copies process.env into _env without re-reading the .envfile from disk, and in start.ts loadEnvAndInitService calls setEnvironments and VaultSecurity.overWriteVaultEnv only once at startup.

In data-transfers/main-process.ts, initializeModels is private and called only once in the constructor for aliases present in this.connections, with no method to reconnect a failed DB alias or initialize missing models later.

In logics/processors/BaseExportProcessor.ts, execute calls this.getConfig() and this.validatePrerequisites(mainProcess, config) synchronously without attempting to reconnect or initialize missing models.
In dbHandler/DbConnectorFactory.ts, connectPostgres creates a new Pool and executes await pool.query('SELECT 1') before returning the DbConnection object.
In data-transfers/main-process.ts, MainProcess automatically polls DB_LIST every 5 seconds to reconnect failed databases and re-initialize missing models.
In svc-env.ts, SVC_ENV.get() watches .run.local.env with fs.watchFile and reloads environment variables on every read.
